subject: Executive cohort intro & quiet briefing request — Evergrid Systems
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@evergrid.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@evergrid.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Executive intro + pre-demo quiet briefing for Evergrid

Hi Asha / Tom,

Thanks again for the time on the call today — excited to line up the product demo for Evergrid. For this next stage we typically do a short "quiet briefing" with your execs (VP/CIO/CTO) 20–30 minutes ahead of the customer-facing demo to cover architecture highlights, security touchpoints, and any redlines for the live session. Goal: ensure the demo stays tight and exec questions are handled without derailing the flow.

Two quick asks so we can book:
- Can you confirm whether VP + CIO will join the briefing, or if you prefer a single exec?
- Do you want the briefing recorded for internal nut-and-bolts notes, or would you prefer no recording?

Proposed briefing options (PT):
- Wed 6/30 08:30–09:00
- Thu 7/1 11:00–11:30
- Fri 7/2 09:00–09:30

I've attached a short draft run-of-show that outlines what we cover (Evergrid-MAP-Draft.pdf). Laura and Jordan will be on the call to support. If you prefer a canary slot on a different day, happy to adapt.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: Evergrid-MAP-Draft.pdf

From: Asha Patel <asha@evergrid.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@evergrid.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive intro + pre-demo quiet briefing for Evergrid

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear options.

Quick answers: VP (Priya Singh) and CIO (Michael Chen) will both join the briefing if we can do Wed 6/30 at 08:30 PT. Prefer we do NOT record the briefing — execs want a closed-room prep.

If you can send an invite for the 08:30 slot we'll accept and add the execs. We'll also loop in our security lead if any SOC/compliance items come up.

Asha
Asha Patel | Head of Product, Evergrid Systems
asha@evergrid.com

Subject: Re: Executive intro + pre-demo quiet briefing for Evergrid

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Asha. Wed 6/30 08:30 PT works for our team as well. A few coordination notes from our side so the briefing is productive and respectful of exec time:

- Format (30 mins): 08:30–08:35 quick intros, 08:35–08:50 architectural highlights + security/controls, 08:50–09:00 exec Q&A and alignment on the customer-facing demo goals.
- Attendees we plan to have on our side: Ben (solution overview), Jordan (technical lead), Laura (exec liaison).
- Recording: noted, we will not record unless you explicitly ask us to. We will take private notes and share an abbreviated follow-up summary.
- Runbook: attaching a prep deck/runbook that lists the talking points and the two demo scenarios we intend to show (briefing-runbook-v1.docx). Please flag anything we should avoid in front of the execs.

Can you confirm final exec names and any dial-in preferences (Zoom link or internal conference bridge)? Once confirmed, Ben will send the calendar invite and include the final runbook.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: briefing-runbook-v1.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@evergrid.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@evergrid.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Wed 6/30 08:30 PT — Exec quiet briefing + demo (Evergrid)

Asha / Tom — confirmed for Wed 6/30 at 08:30 PT (30 minutes). Thanks for confirming VP Priya Singh and CIO Michael Chen will join. We will not record the briefing.

I've attached the final runbook (runbook-final.pdf) and included an .ics invite (calendar-invite.ics) on the thread. Quick checklist:
- Please add the Zoom link or send your preferred dial-in and I'll update the calendar entry.
- Security lead welcome; if they want any materials in advance, send to security@evergrid.com and we'll circulate the appropriate artifact list (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram).
- If anything changes for the execs' attendance, please let me know and Laura will coordinate a 1:1 backup.

Look forward to seeing you Wednesday morning — we'll be tight and respectful of the execs' time.

Best,
Ben
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: runbook-final.pdf, calendar-invite.ics
